frases.texto: At Mars, help from Earth is up to twenty-two minutes away, so astronauts must judge their own health.
NutriVerso maps five body systems with status lights.
Nutrition drives bone and muscle, against personal NASA targets.
Each status says what to do, with source and evidence.
What can wait goes in the weekly report, sent with the real Mars delay.
Ground ranks the crew by severity, with live NASA space weather.
NutriVerso Crew Health. It guides, it does not diagnose.
